definitions.explanation: The part of a telephone that you hold to your ear and speak into. By extension, also used for the handset of a landline phone as a whole. Composed of 受 (receive) + 話 (speech) + 器 (device).

examples.japanese: {受話器|じゅわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{受話器|じゅわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{溜|た}め⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ついた。
examples.english: She hung up the receiver and let out a deep sigh.

examples.japanese: {受話器|じゅわき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{怒鳴|どな}り{声|ごえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きた。
examples.english: I could hear a shouting voice coming from the other end of the receiver.

notes:
USAGE:
{受話器|じゅわき} typically refers to landline phone handsets. With mobile phones, the term is less common, though it may appear in figurative or literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受話器|じゅわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (pick up the receiver)
- {受話器|じゅわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧ (hang up the receiver)
- {受話器|じゅわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{握|にぎ}る→握る：02383_nigiru⟧ (grip the receiver)
- {受話器|じゅわき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧ (hold the receiver to one's ear)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{送話器|そうわき} is the mouthpiece/transmitter (the part you speak into), while {受話器|じゅわき} originally meant the earpiece but now generally refers to the entire handset.
